name: Ōi (Kanagawa, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōi town emblem in green: a ring beneath three stylised leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Ōi, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 August 1965.

features.role: Ōi town emblem — a ring beneath three stylised leaves
